prompt: 看圖寫作：圖中一位男孩在雨中替流浪狗撐傘，哪一句描述最適合當開頭？
options: In the picture, a boy is holding an umbrella over a stray dog in the rain.
In the picture, a boy hold an umbrella over a stray dog in the rain.
In the picture, the rain is a boy and a dog.
answer: In the picture, a boy is holding an umbrella over a stray dog in the rain.

wrong.In the picture, a boy hold an umbrella o: 主詞 a boy 是單數，進行式要用 is holding，不能直接用 hold。
wrong.In the picture, the rain is a boy and a: 這句把 rain 說成男孩與狗，意思錯誤，沒有描述圖中的動作。

why: 開頭先清楚描述圖片：誰、做什麼、在哪裡，進行式 is holding。
tip: 看圖寫作先描述人、動作、場景。
say: In the picture, a boy is holding an umbrella over a stray dog in the rain.

prompt: 選出最適合的連接詞，完成議論文的段落。
text: Some people think homework is helpful. _____, others believe it takes too much time.

wrong.Therefore: 兩種意見相反，不是因果關係。
wrong.For example: 後句是對立看法，不是前句的例子。

why: 兩種相反的看法並列，用 In contrast 呈現對比。
tip: 正反兩面論證，先寫對比連接詞。
say: Some people think homework is helpful. In contrast, others believe it takes too much time.

prompt: 哪一句最適合作為作文的主題句？
options: Learning a second language brings many benefits to young people.
answer: Learning a second language brings many benefits to young people.

這句只是個人喜好，沒有提供可以發展論點的主題。
這是敘述日常事件，與議論主題無關。

why: 主題句要有明確主張，能引出後面的理由與例子。
say: Learning a second language brings many benefits to young people.

prompt: 選出最適合的詞，完成句子。
text: _____ some people disagree, I believe students need more time to sleep.

wrong.Because: 有人不同意不是我相信的原因，用 because 邏輯不通。
wrong.So: So 是「所以」，不能放在句首引出讓步子句。

why: Although 引出讓步，再表達自己的看法，是議論文常用句型。
tip: 寫反方意見用 Although 讓步。
say: Although some people disagree, I believe students need more time to sleep.

prompt: 作文中要給出支持理由，想說「首先，運動使人更健康」。
options: First of all, exercise makes people healthier.
First of all, exercise make people healthy more.
At first all, exercise makes people healthier.
answer: First of all, exercise makes people healthier.

wrong.First of all, exercise make people healt: exercise 是單數主詞，動詞要用 makes，healthy more 比較級也錯。
wrong.At first all, exercise makes people heal: At first all 不是正確的片語，First of all 才是固定開頭。

why: First of all 引出第一個理由，makes people healthier 表示使人更健康。
say: First of all, exercise makes people healthier.

prompt: 哪一句寫作文時語氣最適當？
options: It is widely believed that technology has changed our lives.
Everybody knows tech is totally awesome!!!
answer: It is widely believed that technology has changed our lives.

wrong.Everybody knows tech is totally awesome!: 過度誇張且使用多重驚嘆號，不適合正式作文。
wrong.Tech changes life, ya know?: ya know 太口語，不適合作文。

why: 作文需要正式、有分寸的語氣，It is widely believed that 是常見句型。
tip: 作文避免口語與連續驚嘆號。
say: It is widely believed that technology has changed our lives.

prompt: 選出最適合的答案，完成結論句。
text: _____, I strongly believe that kindness makes the world a better place.

wrong.In addition: In addition 是補充，不適合放在結論句。
wrong.For instance: For instance 引出例子，不是總結主張。

why: 結論段落用 In conclusion 開頭，重述自己的立場。
tip: 結論開頭：In conclusion、To sum up。
say: In conclusion, I strongly believe that kindness makes the world a better place.

prompt: 哪一句的平行結構正確？
options: She enjoys reading, swimming, and painting.
She enjoys reading, to swim, and painting.
She enjoys reading, swim, and painting.
answer: She enjoys reading, swimming, and painting.

wrong.She enjoys reading, to swim, and paintin: 並列項目要形式一致，這裡混用動名詞與不定詞。
swim 是原形動詞，與 reading、painting 不平行。

why: 並列結構要用相同詞類或形式，三個都是動名詞。
say: She enjoys reading, swimming, and painting.

prompt: 圖片顯示兩位學生在圖書館認真讀書，你想描述「他們看起來很專心」。
options: They look very focused on their books.
They look very focus on their books.
They looks very focused on their books.
answer: They look very focused on their books.

focus 是動詞或名詞，look 後面要用形容詞 focused。
主詞 They 是複數，動詞要用 look，不加 s。

why: look + 形容詞 表示看起來…，主詞 They 搭配 look。
tip: look + 形容詞，描述看起來的樣子。
say: They look very focused on their books.

text: Parents should _____ their children to express their own opinions.

wrong.force: force 是強迫，與表達自己的意見的自由相反。
wrong.forbid: forbid 是禁止，與鼓勵表達意見語意相反。

why: encourage + 人 + to V 表示鼓勵某人做某事。
tip: encourage sb. to V：鼓勵某人做…
say: Parents should encourage their children to express their own opinions.

prompt: 哪一句是較好的反方論點（counterargument）寫法？
options: Some may argue that games waste time; however, they can also teach teamwork.
Some people say games are bad, but they are silly.
answer: Some may argue that games waste time; however, they can also teach teamwork.

沒有提出反方意見，也沒有理由。
wrong.Some people say games are bad, but they: 只用 silly 嘲笑反方，沒有給出理由回應。

why: 好的反方論點先承認不同看法，再用理由回應。
tip: 先承認反方，再用理由回應。
say: Some may argue that games waste time; however, they can also teach teamwork.

text: To make an essay more convincing, you should support your opinion with specific _____.

wrong.exams: exams 是考試，與支持論點的具體內容無關。
wrong.excuses: excuses 是藉口，不能增加說服力。

why: 具體例子（examples）能支持觀點，讓作文更有說服力。
tip: 論點後面要有具體例子支持。
say: You should support your opinion with specific examples.
